rules.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank fires, the shot power must be between 0.1 and 3.0 inclusive, and the tank's current energy must be strictly greater than that power.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> (((p.0 as int) >= 100) && ((p.0 as int) <= 3000) && ((obs.energy.0 as int) > (p.0 as int)))

rules.text: Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank fires, it must have a target that was scanned this turn (age 0) and its gun must be pointing at that target within 3.0°, so firing with no target, a stale scan, or a misaimed gun is never allowed.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> ((obs.target matches Some(t) && t.age == 0) && aimed(*obs))

rules.text: Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank drives forward, the free distance ahead minus the distance driven must remain at least 80 pixels, and whenever it drives backward, the free distance behind minus the distance driven backward must remain at least 80 pixels; if it does not drive, neither condition applies.
clauses: r.ahead matches Some(a) ==> (a > 0 ==> (((around.clearance_ahead as int) - (a as int)) >= 80))
r.ahead matches Some(a) ==> (a < 0 ==> (((around.clearance_behind as int) + (a as int)) >= 80))

explanation.headline: Proved: all 3 rules hold
explanation.summary: Verus proved all three rules: S1 (never fire a shot it can't afford), S2 (only fire at a robot seen this turn with the gun aimed at it) and S3 (never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px). Neither battle, in the open arena or the city map, recorded any rule violations.
